<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. By examining the chemical shift values in the aromatic region (approximately 110–160 ppm), I can count how many distinct aromatic carbon signals are present, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
